title: Question on the page "searchBox"

comments.body:
The `autocomplete=off` actually means the native autocomplete you can see in any text box, this is disabled here because it often colludes with what users actually want to type. If you want to use autocomplete on a searchbox, this is the simplest way to do it: 

https://codesandbox.io/s/rlp0m6yp

To complement @Haroenv answer, and to more specifically answer the part in which you express the need for custom markup, you could try to use the [searchbox connector](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/connectors/connectSearchBox.html).
Closing for inactivity. Feel free to reopen if your problem remains unsolved.
